A_target.statement:
Let $V$ be an [[Definition:Inner Product Space|inner product space]] and $\mathbf u, \mathbf v \in V$ with $\mathbf u \perp \mathbf v$.
Then:
:$
orm {\mathbf u + \mathbf v}^2 = 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 + 
orm {\mathbf v}^2$

B_source.statement:
Let $V$ be an [[Definition:Inner Product Space|inner product space]] and $\mathbf u, \mathbf v \in V$.
Then:
:$
orm {\mathbf u + \mathbf v}^2 + 
orm {\mathbf u - \mathbf v}^2 = 2 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 + 2 
orm {\mathbf v}^2$

object_map.reformulation: Under orthogonality, the two diagonals of the parallelogram have equal length.

proof_plan:
Then:
:$
orm {\mathbf u \pm \mathbf v}^2 = 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 \pm 2 \innerprod {\mathbf u} {\mathbf v} + 
orm {\mathbf v}^2 = 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 + 
orm {\mathbf v}^2$
so $
orm {\mathbf u - \mathbf v} = 
orm {\mathbf u + \mathbf v}$.

Substituting into the [[Parallelogram Law (Inner Product Space)|parallelogram law]]:
:$2 
orm {\mathbf u + \mathbf v}^2 = 2 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 + 2 
orm {\mathbf v}^2$

Dividing by $2$:
:$
orm {\mathbf u + \mathbf v}^2 = 
orm {\mathbf u}^2 + 
orm {\mathbf v}^2$
{{qed}}
